_source: Manual confirmations recorded in the fee-match review tool (https://claude.ai/artifact/EDFVTKdwrc9Aj8yWkJKJQy), read from its own database.
_why: Waterloo, UNB and uOttawa each publish fees by a category — faculty, degree, or programme band — that a course row does not name, so the row-to-category match was reviewed by hand rather than guessed. These are those decisions.
_basis: Each decision carries the category chosen and the basis the figure is stated on. The basis differs by university and must not be flattened: UNB is annual, Waterloo is a first-year total over two terms including incidental fees, uOttawa is per term or per unit. A choice of "none" means none of the offered categories fitted, and that row stays on request.
